user.title: Configure Zendure Local Battery
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Zendure battery device. The integration will connect directly over your local network using the ZenSDK HTTP API.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered Zendure Device
zeroconf_confirm.description: Discovered Zendure {model} ({serial}) at {host}. Would you like to set up local control for this battery?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to device. Verify the IP address and ensure the device is on the same subnet/VLAN as Home Assistant.
error.timeout: Connection timed out connecting to the device.
error.hems_not_enabled: Local HTTP API is not responding. Under EN 18031, you must add HEMS in the Zendure mobile app and then exit to apply local API access.
error.missing_serial: Could not determine serial number from device report.
error.unknown_device: Could not identify a valid Zendure device from discovery.

abort.unknown_device: Discovered service did not supply a valid Zendure serial

data.volatile_writes: Volatile writes (smartMode: 1) - memory only, avoids flash wear

ip_unreachable.title: Zendure device {serial} unreachable
ip_unreachable.description: Home Assistant cannot reach Zendure device {serial} at IP address {host}. Automatic rediscovery has been triggered. Please ensure the battery is powered on and connected to your network.
